summary: Tuya Inc., a Cayman-incorporated, Hong Kong-listed foreign private issuer (US ADR ticker TUYA), submitted a routine monthly return to the Stock Exchange of Hong Kong for September 2026, filed with the SEC as a Form 6-K. The return discloses only minute share-count movements: 32,524 new Class A ordinary shares issued, lifting the total to 543,239,431, with authorized capital unchanged at USD 50,000 and public float compliance confirmed at the 25% threshold. No transaction, stake, price, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal terms appear. This is an ordinary listing-maintenance disclosure, not a special situation.
